description: This file defines the BeanFactory class responsible for creating, managing, and caching SugarBean objects in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for retrieving beans by ID, creating new beans, handling shallow beans, and managing bean cache and file loading logic.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating, retrieving, caching, and managing SugarBean objects within the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: getBean
methods.description: Returns a SugarBean object by ID, caching recent beans to optimize retrieval. Creates a new bean if ID is not provided.

methods.name: getReloadedBean
methods.description: Retrieves a fresh instance of a SugarBean by ID, bypassing cache.

methods.name: getShallowBean
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a shallow bean used for relationship purposes without caching it for general use.

methods.name: convertParams
methods.description: Converts the parameters for bean retrieval, handling boolean and array inputs.

methods.name: initBeanRegistry
methods.description: Initializes the internal registries for loaded beans and touched status for a given module.

methods.name: hasEncodeFlag
methods.description: Extracts the encode flag from parameters, defaults to true.

methods.name: hasDeletedFlag
methods.description: Determines the deleted flag from parameters, defaults to provided argument.

methods.name: newBean
methods.description: Creates a new bean instance for the specified module.

methods.name: getBeanMeta
methods.description: Provides metadata information about the bean for a given module.

methods.name: getBeanName
methods.description: Retrieves the core bean name for a module from global configuration.

methods.name: getCustomBeanName
methods.description: Retrieves the custom bean name for a module from global configuration.

methods.name: getBeanClass
methods.description: Returns the bean class for a module, preferring custom over core.

methods.name: getObjectName
methods.description: Returns the object name used as a key in the dictionary for a module.

methods.name: getCustomObjectName
methods.description: Returns the custom object name for a module.

methods.name: getBeanFile
methods.description: Gets the filepath for the core bean class for a module.

methods.name: getCustomBeanFile
methods.description: Gets the filepath for the custom bean class for a module.

methods.name: loadBeanFile
methods.description: Loads the core and custom bean class files for a module if they exist.

methods.name: registerBean
methods.description: Registers a bean in the cache for quick subsequent access, managing cache size.

methods.name: unregisterBean
methods.description: Removes a bean from cache by module and ID.
